phase_0.boundary_condition: The fifth palace of the thylakoid membrane

VINIT.justification: The uninitialized state prior to photon absorption.

TANCH.justification: The terminal boundary containing the proton gradient.

AFWD.justification: Directed energy transfer toward the reaction center.

AREV.justification: The reverse descent of energy back to the ground state.

CLINK.justification: Sequential chaining of energy transfer steps.

IMSCRIB.justification: Self-recognition of the molecule via resonance.

FSPLIT.justification: Splitting of the exciton into electron and hole paths.

FFUSE.justification: Reuniting the electron and hole to reset the system.

EVALT.justification: Successful conversion of light to chemical potential.

EVALF.justification: Failure to capture energy resulting in heat loss.

ENGAGR.justification: Both energy pathways held simultaneously in superposition.

IFIX.justification: Permanent fixation of the electron into the transport chain.

phase_3.void_description: The dark state before photon arrival.
phase_3.true_description: The excited state successfully performing work.
phase_3.false_description: The ground state failing to capture energy.
phase_3.both_description: The coherent superposition of energy states.

steps.domain_action: Branch the exciton into electron and hole paths.
Maintain quantum coherence across both paths.
Direct the electron toward the transport chain.
Account for thermal dissipation in the system.
Reverse the descent of the hole to the donor.
Reconstitute the ground state of the pigment.
Chain the next exciton transfer event.
Anchor the process within the thylakoid lumen.

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The system maintains order through the conversion of light into chemical potential within a closed membrane.
